workItem: Add bounded, redacted GitHub Enterprise HTTP 403 diagnostics to the existing read-only settings inventory without exposing credentials, SSO authorization URLs or raw provider headers.
workItemDE: Begrenzte und redigierte GitHub-Enterprise-HTTP-403-Diagnostik in das bestehende read-only Settings-Inventar integrieren, ohne Credentials, SSO-Autorisierungs-URLs oder rohe Provider-Header offenzulegen.
priorityReason: Run #35992205549 proved the three Enterprise Actions policy reads still return HTTP 403 even though the configured token is a classic PAT with admin:enterprise according to current Human Owner evidence.
scopeBoundary: Read-only Enterprise settings diagnostics only; no GitHub provider setting mutation.
Only bounded OAuth-scope names, accepted-scope names, SSO-presence boolean, rate-limit counters/resource and a sanitized provider reason may cross the evidence boundary.
The X-GitHub-SSO header value, SSO authorization URL, Authorization header, PAT value, GitHub App private key and unknown/raw headers must never be logged, persisted or exported.
No PAT scope, IAM, Enterprise policy, billing, repository permission, workflow permission or deployment mutation is authorized.
exitEvidence: HTTP 403/404 failures expose a bounded providerDiagnostics object without raw headers.
SSO is represented only as ssoRequired=true/false; the X-GitHub-SSO value is discarded.
OAuth and accepted OAuth scopes are allow-pattern filtered and deduplicated.
Rate-limit evidence is restricted to numeric limit/remaining/reset and a bounded resource name.
Provider message URLs and token-like values are redacted before projection and re-redacted at the evidence boundary.
Targeted unit tests cover diagnostics and redaction.
Exact-head repository checks remain truthful; Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.

releaseEvidence.reason: PR #1397 merged and Run #35999363977 proved full Enterprise settings readback PASS.
